text:
The dish looks like a round paper plate about 20 cm across, though it may be closer to 18 cm. It holds roughly 22 grapes, mostly red with 2-3 green ones.

Red grapes here are fairly large, around 5-6 g each. 22 grapes × 5.5 g ≈ 120 g. Grapes run about 0.69 kcal/g, so that is roughly 85 kcal.

Allowing for a few more grapes that may be hidden, I'll round up to about 130 g and 90 kcal.

{"kcal": 90, "mass_g": 130}
